Generate a self-signed TLS certificate and RSA key for development use.
Example:
  trace genkey --host localhost --out ~/.trace/tls

Usage:
  trace genkey [flags]

Flags:
      --bits int      RSA key size in bits (default 2048)
  -h, --help          help for genkey
      --host string   certificate hostname or IP (default "localhost")
      --out string    output directory (default ~/.trace/tls)

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file
